speaker: Narrator
text: *The chamber opens into a vast space lined with runes. In the center lies a shattered altar, glowing faintly with ancient magic.*

speaker: Nora
text: This energy... it's thick. I can feel it crawling over my skin.

speaker: Kyle
text: We're close. The Wraith's presence... it's everywhere.

speaker: Arcane Wraith
text: Ah, the last child of the broken swords. And the little witch who betrayed her own blood. How... poetic.

speaker: Nora
text: You're the one behind the destruction... the blood... the screams. Your corruption ends here.

speaker: Arcane Wraith
text: Oh, but your hands are not clean, girl. And you, boy... tell me, how does the Blade Edge feel pulsing in your grip? Tempting, isn’t it?

speaker: Kyle
text: I didn't come here to talk. I came to end you.

speaker: Arcane Wraith
text: End me? No, no... I am the end, child. Come then. Let the abyss claim what's left of you.

speaker: Narrator
text: *The ground shakes as spectral flames swirl around the altar. The Wraith rises in an ethereal form, ready to strike.*
